headline: GTA 6 Review Roundup – Grand Theft Auto VI Is Now The Highest Rated Game Of All Time
briefing: Top stories right now: GTA 6 Review Roundup – Grand Theft Auto VI Is Now The Highest Rated Game Of All Time; New Toronto city council set to hold first meeting since election; and Raptors again struggle in fourth quarter in second consecutive loss to Knicks.

keyDates.label: APEC summit opens; Alaska ranked-choice count
keyDates.why: Leaders meet in Shenzhen on Nov. 18–19, and Alaska tabulates its Peltola–Sullivan Senate race if no one tops 50%.

keyDates.label: Trump meets Xi and Putin
keyDates.why: Trump holds a one-on-one with Xi and then a first-ever three-way meeting with Xi and Putin in Shenzhen, with nuclear weapons the stated focus.

keyDates.label: Senate Democrats vote; Stelco recall
keyDates.why: Democratic senators choose between Chuck Schumer and Chris Van Hollen for majority leader by secret ballot, and 175 laid-off Stelco workers are due back in Hamilton.

keyDates.label: Bank of Canada and Fed rate decisions
keyDates.why: Both central banks decide the same day; the Bank of Canada has said more hikes are possible.

keyDates.label: U.S. government funding deadline
keyDates.why: Federal funding runs out unless the outgoing Congress passes a spending bill or a temporary extension, which is also the likeliest vehicle for any new air traffic control money.
